question: Accept validation PASSED for the boot receipt guard, and finalize 4c?

artifacts.summary: PASSED. The material finding is fixed and validation proved it rather than accepting the account: its own matrix, extended to 30 assertions, shows the three spuriously-refusing shapes now failing open with a warning naming the receipt path; none of the 11 already-fail-open rows flipped; the true positive still refuses; detection is undiminished. It attacked the widened fail-open as instructed and found no read error that should refuse and now escapes — empty, whitespace-only and garbage receipts reach the parse path, a dangling symlink still refuses. All four fixes independently falsifiable: reverting each single line turned exactly its own regression test red. Version skew is a non-issue both directions because Go's time.Parse accepts an optional fractional second regardless of layout, proven directly and end-to-end with a pre-fix receipt. Cycle-2 surface confined: net +172 across exactly 4 files, only 25 lines of product code. One correction validation volunteered against itself: its cycle-1 finding bundled a read-only-project-root shape with the two genuine AC-2 violations, and that shape belongs to AC-1's approved never-booted detection instead — recorded as a deferred risk, not a blocker. Three deferred risks carry promote conditions: cwd/workflow git-root divergence, receipt-line whitespace (all failure modes fail open), and the read-only root. Cumulative surface net +814 across 14 files against the approved +245 — 332%, disclosed at every round and never trimmed by cutting coverage.
